adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff at line 147 in GoogleCalendarService.ts, the code finds the calendar by matching `cal.credentialId === credentialId`. If a destination calendar has a null credentialId (legacy data), the find() will return undefined, and `selectedCalendar` will be undefined, causing the code to fall back to 'primary' instead of using the configured externalId. The old code used `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.externalId` directly which would work for legacy destinations. This is a real regression for legacy data where credentialId might be null.
